pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly polygonal dark regions with varying spatial dimensions. Edges are characterized by soft pixel gradients rather than sharp transitions. Larger patches are clustered on the mid-flank, while smaller, more fragmented patches appear towards the lower neck and posterior.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Network of light-toned pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junctions primarily consist of three-way nodes. Continuity is maintained throughout the visible mid-section with relatively uniform pixel thickness.
